artworks.title: Tyndareus (mosaic detail, House of the Tragic Poet, Pompeii)
artworks.description: Roman mosaic from Pompeii preserves the name of Tyndareus, the Spartan king whom Apollodorus in one genealogy makes a son of Oebalus and the Naiad Batia. Classical art rarely depicts the nymph herself; her myth survives in the genealogical prose that explains how a daughter of the springs entered the house of the Dioscuri.
